Executive Summary We compare data sets from FleetDNA and the Bourns College of Engineering – Center for Environmental Research and Technology (CE-CERT) to defaults in the MOtor Vehicle Emission Simulator 3 (MOVES3) in consideration of updating speed and vehicle miles traveled (VMT) distributions for heavy-duty source types. We categorize the data by hour of the day on weekends and weekdays for four different road types, including freeways and other roads in urban and rural areas. Addressing only conventional vehicles in this report, we include gasoline- and diesel-fueled vehicles and exclude propane, hydrogen, electric, hybrid, and other advanced fuel vehicles. The FleetDNA and CE-CERT data are resolved to individual truck vocations and the MOVES source type, whereas the heavy-duty speed distributions in MOVES3 are aggregated across two weight class categories and applied to several source types; this report seeks to give insight into source- and vocation- specific vehicle behaviors.
